question: How do I submit a paper?
answer: Papers should be submitted through the EasyChair portal. Please format your paper using the IEEE double-column template. Full papers should be 6-8 pages including references. Ensure all author-identifying information is removed for double-blind review.

question: What is the paper acceptance rate?
answer: ICSSG-AI maintains a competitive acceptance rate of approximately 30-35% to ensure high-quality research publications. All papers undergo rigorous double-blind peer review by at least two domain experts.

question: Can I present a poster instead of a full paper?
answer: Yes, we accept poster presentations for work-in-progress, early-stage research, and student contributions. Poster abstracts (2-4 pages) can be submitted through the same EasyChair portal.

question: What are the registration fees?
answer: Registration fees vary by category: Students (₹3,000–4,000), Research Scholars (₹4,000–5,500), Faculty (₹5,500–7,000), Industry (₹8,000–10,000), and International ($200–300). Early bird discounts are available until December 15, 2026.

question: Is there a group discount?
answer: Yes, groups of 5 or more from the same institution receive a 10% discount on registration fees. Please contact us at icssg-ai@bgu.ac.in for group registration details.

question: What is included in the registration?
answer: Registration includes access to all conference sessions, conference kit, lunch and refreshments for all three days, certificate of participation, and access to conference proceedings. Additional benefits vary by registration tier.

question: Where will the conference be held?
answer: ICSSG-AI 2027 will be held at Birla Global University campus in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. The campus is located at IDCO Plot No.2, Gothapatna, approximately 15 km from Biju Patnaik International Airport.

question: How do I reach the venue from the airport?
answer: The venue is approximately 15 km from Biju Patnaik International Airport (BBI). Taxi and ride-sharing services are readily available. We will also arrange shuttle services for registered participants during the conference days.

question: Is accommodation provided?
answer: While the conference does not provide complimentary accommodation, we have partnered with several hotels near the venue offering discounted rates. Campus guest house accommodation is also available on a first-come-first-served basis.

question: Will the conference proceedings be published?
answer: Yes, all accepted and presented papers will be published in IEEE Conference Proceedings, indexed in IEEE Xplore. Selected best papers will be invited for extended versions in Springer LNCS.

question: Can I attend virtually?
answer: ICSSG-AI 2027 is primarily an in-person conference. However, keynote sessions will be live-streamed for registered virtual participants at a reduced registration fee.

question: Is there a visa invitation letter?
answer: Yes, we provide official visa invitation letters for accepted authors and registered international participants. Please email icssg-ai@bgu.ac.in with your registration confirmation for the letter.
